records.source_Japanese:
流行（交易所→相場情報）
流行している交易品の価格は高騰します。
流行は、自然発生する場合と、[[117|宣教師]]が意図的に起こす場合があります。
流行品を大量に販売すると、シェアを無料でもらえることがあります。[[151|独占契約]]中の街では、紹介状・推薦状をもらえることがあります。[[38|紹介状]]・[[39|推薦状]]を総督府に持っていくと、それまで契約できなかった街でも契約できることがあります。

amounts of fashionable goods may earn you 
market share for free. In towns under an
[[151|Exclusive Contract,]] you may receive a
Letter of Introduction or Recommendation. 
[[213|Continue reading]]

governor's office, and you may be able to

records.source_Japanese:
契約（王宮・総督府）
街と契約を結びます。
１～20口単位で契約できます。
口数に応じて[[150|シェア]]がもらえ、その街で交易できるようになります。
すでに３つの勢力と契約を結んでいる街、または、すでに他勢力のシェア合計が 100％になっている街とは契約できません。
records.previous_English:
Contract (Palace) 
Sign a contract with the town, from 1 to
20 units at a time. You gain[[150| Market Share]]
according to the number of units, 
allowing you to trade there. You cannot 
sign a contract if the town already has 
contracts with three factions, or if
other factions already hold a combined
100 percent share.
records.english: Contract (Palace) Sign a contract with the town, from 1 to 20 units at a time. You gain[[150| Market Share]] according to the number of units, allowing you to trade there. You cannot sign a contract if the town already has contracts with three factions, or if other factions already hold a combined 100 percent share.
records.localization_note: The article uses the command name and clearly gives the purchase range, trade access and two restrictions.

records.source_Japanese:
軍事投資（王宮・総督府）
街の防衛設備に投資します。１口～20口単位で投資できます。１口につき街の武装度の50％（ラファエルは40％）分の金貨が必要です。
投資すると武装度が上がります。街の[[150|シェア]]合計が 100％に満たないか、または[[187|交戦中]]の勢力がシェアを所有しているときは、自勢力のシェアが上がります。武装度が高いと、攻撃されたとき降伏しにくくなるほか、良い船や大砲が購入できるようになります。
records.previous_English:
Military Investment (Palace / Governor's
Office) 
Invest in a city's defenses, from 1 to 20 
units at a time. Each unit costs gold 
equal to 50 percent of the city's Arms
rating, or 40 percent for Rafael. 
[[204|Continue reading]]

current_continuations.previous_English:
Military Investment (continued) 
Investment raises the city's Arms rating. 
Your market share also rises if the 
city's total[[150| market share]] is below 100 
percent or a faction you are[[187| at war]] with 
owns a share. A higher Arms rating makes
the city less likely to surrender when
attacked and allows you to buy better 
ships and cannons.
[[37|Back to article start]]

records.heading: Military Investment
records.english: Invest in the town's defenses in groups of 1 to 20 units. Each unit costs gold equal to 50 percent of the town's Arms rating, or 40 percent for Rafael. A higher Arms rating makes a town less likely to surrender when attacked and lets you buy better ships and cannons.

records.source_Japanese:
紹介状を使う（王宮・総督府）
[[25|交易所でもらった紹介状]]を、王・総督に渡します。街の規模が「港」のときのみ使えます。
[[36|契約]]済みの街で使うと[[150|シェア]]が５％増えます。契約がない街で使うと、契約を結べます。すでに他勢力のシェア合計が 100％の街でも、他勢力のシェアを１％奪って契約できます。
ただし、すでに３勢力と契約を結んでいる街、自勢力のシェアが 100％の街では使えません。
records.previous_English:
Use Letter of Introduction (Palace) 
Give the ruler or governor a
[[25|Letter of Introduction from the market.]]
It works only in towns classed as Ports.
If you already have a [[36|contract,]] your 
[[150|Market Share]] rises by 5 percent.
Otherwise, you can sign a contract. 
[[214|Continue reading]]

current_continuations.previous_English:
Use Letter of Introduction (continued)
Even if other factions hold a combined
100 percent share, you can take 1 percent 
from them to sign. You cannot use the 
letter if the town already has contracts
with three factions, or if you already
hold 100 percent of its share.
[[38|Back to article start]]

records.heading: Introduction (Palace)
records.english: Give the ruler or governor a [[25|Letter of Introduction]] from the Market. You can use it only in Ports. If you already have a [[36|contract,]] your [[150|market share]] rises by 5 percentage points. Otherwise, the letter lets you sign a contract. You can sign even if other factions hold a combined 100 percent share. In that case, you take 1 percentage point from those factions. You cannot use the letter if the town already has contracts with three factions or your faction holds a 100 percent share.
records.localization_note: Match the Introduction action and the Market name. Keep the Port restriction and give the exact increase in points.

アイテムを貸す（王宮・総督府）
王・総督に手持ちのアイテムを貸します。本拠地の王宮・総督府でのみ実行できます。
貸している間は、アイテムの価値に応じて毎月、賃貸料が入ります。ただし、「[[4|覇者の証]]」「証の地図」「[[142|古の地図]]」は貸せません。
records.previous_English:
Lend Item (Palace)
Lend an item to the ruler of your home
city. Earn monthly rent based on value. 
[[4|Proofs of Conquest,]] Proof Maps, and
[[142|Ancient Maps]] cannot be lent.
records.heading: Lend Item (Palace)
records.english: Lend an item to the ruler or governor at your home port. You'll collect rent each month based on the item's value. You cannot lend [[4|Proofs of Conquest,]] Proof Maps, or [[142|Ancient Maps.]]

武装度（街データ）
街の武装度を表します。
王宮・総督府で「[[37|軍事投資]]」をすると上がります。高いほど、攻撃されたときに降伏しにくくなります。

Arms
Arms measures how well a city is armed. 
It rises when you make
[[37|military investments]] at the Palace or 
Governor's Office. Higher Arms makes a
city less likely to surrender 
when attacked.
